target.description: Target domain to scan for subdomains (required)

wordlist_file.description: Path to external wordlist file (optional; if omitted, built-in wordlist is used)

delay_ms.description: Maximum delay in milliseconds between DNS queries (must be 1–300000; default: 10)

ips_to_ignore.description: List of IP addresses to exclude from results (up to 5 IPs; use commas without spaces in original dnsmap CLI, but here as list of strings)

output_dir.description: Directory to save text (-r) and CSV (-c) results (default: current directory, results named dynamically)
